content: ESP32 deep sleep draws ~5-10uA (bare module) vs ~240mA active; dev boards draw more (1-5mA) due to onboard peripherals (USB-UART chip, LDO). Common vehicle-tracker pattern: TPS54240-class buck converter steps 12V down, MP2617-class Li-ion charger ICs charge a 3.7-4.2V backup cell while vehicle power is present, ESP32 runs off the backup cell when 12V is absent. Movement-gated deep sleep (wake on timer or accel interrupt, sleep when stationary) is the standard low-power GPS tracker pattern.
